data.one_liner: Digit-by-digit animated rolling numbers and clocks with locale formatting and physics springs.
data.what_it_does: Provides NumberFlow and TimeFlow widgets that animate numerical values and time display with odometer-style digit rolling. It supports locale-aware formatting, spring physics, velocity-based motion blur, and high-frequency scrubbing.
use_when: You need animated counters, currency amounts, or statistics that roll digit-by-digit.
You are building a stopwatch, countdown timer, or wall clock with smooth digit transitions.
You need to drive number displays at high frequency from a slider or chart scrubber.
avoid_when: You only need standard static text displays without any numerical rolling animations.
You require a complete physics game engine.
strengths: Only animates digits that actually change.
Supports complex formatting including currency, percent, compact, and scientific notation.
Includes built-in accessibility semantics and respects reduced-motion preferences.
weaknesses: Limited to specific number flow and time flow display scenarios.
Depends on the intl package for formatting rules.

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose flutter_animate if you need a general-purpose animation library for fade, slide, and scale effects on any widget.
